manifest.name: Cloudinary
manifest.description:
Contentstack' Marketplace Apps offers a variety of ways to integrate third-party applications, such as Cloudinary, directly into your headless CMS. With the Cloudinary app, you can streamline the process of managing and sharing images across multiple platforms.

Custom Field or JSON RTE, you can integrate Cloudinary with Contentstack directly. You can create content in Contentstack, and Cloudinary will ensure that you are able to view and access your Cloudinary images within your CMS.

meta.name: Cloudinary
meta.description: Using the JSON RTE plugin, you can view and access your Cloudinary images within your CMS.

meta.name: Cloudinary
meta.description: Using the Custom Field, you can view and access your Cloudinary images within your CMS.

manifest.name: Bynder
manifest.description:
Contentstack's Marketplace apps offer a variety of ways to integrate third-party applications, such as Bynder, directly into your headless CMS. With this, you can streamline the process of managing and sharing digital assets across multiple platforms.

Using a Contentstack Custom Field, you can integrate Bynder with Contentstack directly. You can create an entry in Contentstack, the app will ensure that you are able to view the digital assets within your CMS.

manifest.name: Color Picker
manifest.description:
To further enhance the business user experience, Contentstack provides prebuilt custom field extensions that let you extend the functionality of your custom fields to serve your unique business needs while providing a native Contentstack look and feel.

With Contentstack Custom Fields, you can now select a color as an input. With the Color Picker custom field, you can select and adjust color values.

meta.name: Color Picker
meta.description: While creating entries, you can select a color as an input.

manifest.name: Image Preset Builder
manifest.description:
The Image Preset Builder app is a collection of formatting tools that help transform and optimize assets in the stack. You can build customized presets for any image file to tailor your assets as per your business requirements.

Image Preset Builder allows you to use varied preset versions of assets across your entries. With the help of this app, you can add image presets to fields such as Custom Field extensions or the JSON Rich Text Editor.

Developer Documentation:

To render the image presets built from the Image Preset Builder app in your project using the App Utils functions, please refer to the Render Images using Image Preset Builder section of the installation guide.

manifest.name: Developer Tools
manifest.description:
The Developer Tools app enhances the developer experience within the CMS by offering code snippets and automated schema generation.

By leveraging Developer Tools, developers can quickly access the required code snippets, reducing manual effort and improving efficiency when integrating content into their applications

manifest.name: Aprimo
manifest.description:
With the Contentstack Marketplace Aprimo integration, into your headless CMS, you can easily manage and share digital assets across multiple platforms.

Using the Custom Field and JSON RTE plugin, you can integrate Aprimo with Contentstack. You can create an entry in Contentstack and, with the integration, view all the digital assets in Contentstack.

meta.name: Aprimo
meta.description: Custom field allows you to select multiple images to add them to your entry from your Aprimo account.

meta.name: Aprimo
meta.description: You can add images from the Aprimo app to your JSON Rich Text Editor field using the Aprimo JSON RTE Plugin.

manifest.name: AI Assistant
manifest.description:
Contentstack Marketplace lets you integrate the AI Assistant app to quickly and easily create summaries, outlines, metadata tags and descriptions, headlines, even full-length keyword-optimized blogs all with just a few clicks.

You can choose to generate, regenerate and replace content for the current field. Also, generate content for an entry field based on another field. You can also provide a custom command to manipulate the data based on your instructions.

With the Contentstack Entry Field UI location, you can access the AI Assistant app in different entry field types such as Title, Single Line Textbox, Multi-Line Textbox, HTML-based Rich Text Editor, JSON Rich Text Editor and Markdown.

meta.name: AI Assistant
meta.description: The JsonRTE Field plugin location allows you to use AI Assistant on selected content.

meta.name: AI Assistant
meta.description: Entry Field UI location allows you to enable the AI Assistant app in different field types.

manifest.name: Workflow Board
manifest.description:
Contentstack Marketplace lets you integrate the Workflow Board app directly into your headless CMS. You can easily use this app to view and manage the Workflow Stages in a Kanban format.

Using Contentstack, you can now add a Workflow Board app in your stack and view the list of Workflows along with the Workflow Stages and Workflow Tasks for Content Types within your Contentstack environment. Also, the app lets you search for workflows and entries in the Workflow Board app.

The app displays the workflow tasks in different workflow stages. You can drag and drop the workflow tasks from one workflow stage to another and update them with the required details directly. You can edit the Workflow stage of an entry only if you have the required permissions.

You can also view the total number of workflow task assignees in the User(s) and Role(s) categories in the Workflow Board app.

meta.name: Workflow Board
meta.description: It previews the Workflow stages and Workflow tasks for the selected content types within the stack.

manifest.name: Calendar
manifest.description:
Contentstack Marketplace lets you integrate the Calendar app directly into your headless CMS. You can easily use this app to display the assigned Workflow tasks and scheduled events, such as publish entries and releases on a calendar board.

Using Contentstack, you can add a Calendar app to your stack and view the events on the scheduled dates within your Contentstack environments. The app uses color codes and icons to differentiate the task, publish, and release events. Also, you can view the event details in the right-hand side of the board. The app also provides month, timeline, and week view options of the events.

meta.name: Calendar
meta.description: It shows a calendar for assigned tasks, scheduled entries, and releases and a sidebar showing the detailed content.

manifest.name: Automate
manifest.description:
By integrating the Automate app into your headless CMS, you can effortlessly manage and execute automations created in Contentstack’s Automate.

You can view the Automate app in the Entry Sidebar UI location and bring all the capabilities of Automate within your entry editor in the CMS. You can see a list of all the active automations ready for execution, simply click the Execute icon to run an automation.

manifest.name: Audience Insights
manifest.description:
Supercharge your content strategy with the Audience Insights app from Contentstack Marketplace! Seamlessly integrate your Lytics Customer Data Platform and gain precise audience data analysis directly within your headless CMS.

The app understands how well your content resonates with target audiences by leveraging behavioral and demographic data. Deliver your messaging to the right audience segments and make strategic content decisions that drive engagement. Whether you are analyzing individual entries or exploring trends across pages, the Audience Insights app provides powerful insights to boost your content performance.

Once installed, you can effortlessly analyze audience data and enhance your personalization strategies.
